payload.text: Doom/MELPA rename: the pin is EXECUTED in Molt-matts at b168c86 (verified by read, 9 Nov), rollout outstanding. hv's decision 52 shape, as rhadamanth-sysadm built it: a recipe override in config/doom/init.el lines 22-24, above (doom!), '(defvar straight-recipe-overrides nil)' then setf of (alist-get 'melpa (alist-get nil straight-recipe-overrides)) to Doom's own recipe plus :branch "main". init.el rather than packages.el or cli.el because Doom registers its recipe repos after init.el loads and before packages.el, and init.el is loaded by both the doom CLI and startup; rhadamanth-sysadm's 'doom sync -u' on rhadamanth exits 0 with no recipe-conflict warning, which is this fix's one layer of proof. Molt ships no change: editors_maintain (liberators/editors.sh:330-364) keeps surfacing the fault, which is correct. OUTSTANDING: hv pushes Molt-matts, which is ahead 3 of upstream/main (b168c86 over b2c8818 markdownlint and 9643bef frame position), then each sleeve pulls and runs 'doom sync -u'; a pull alone suffices, since config/doom is a plain symlink and needs no molt upgrade. rhadamanth-sysadm drives the sleeves (it tells kovacs-sysadm and gyges-sysadm; molt-vc sends them nothing, so it is said once). Untested by either of us and NOT covering it: whether :branch repairs an already-stale single-branch clone; expected not to, since straight fetches with the clone's own refspec, so a stale clone still needs rhadamanth-sysadm's hand repair. If upstream Doom adds :branch "main", this override becomes identical and inert. Archive when the sleeves have it, on rhadamanth-sysadm's word.
